A dramatic historical illustration. In the foreground, King Zedekiah of Judah, looking distressed, is held by Babylonian soldiers in armor. Behind him, his young sons are about to be executed. In the background, the walls of Jerusalem are breached, and smoke rises from the burning Temple and city buildings.

Nehemiah riding on a horse at night, looking down at the rubble and broken stones of the ruined walls of Jerusalem. The moon is out, casting long shadows. A few attendants stand quietly behind him with torches.
